description: This file contains test functions for the 'rockpaperscissors' game, including unit tests for game initialization, winner determination, game playing logic, and user interaction via prompts.

classes.name: gameCombination
classes.description: Struct used for testing different game move combinations and expected outcomes in various modes.

classes.name: MockPrompter
classes.description: Mock implementation of the Prompter interface for simulating user input in tests.

classes.name: mockPromptSequence
classes.description: Struct for sequencing predefined responses and errors to simulate user choices during tests.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Struct representing the game state for testing purposes with methods like getWinner, Play, isGameOver, updateScore, getGameOverMessage, and getRoundResultMessage.

methods.name: TestNewGame
methods.description: Test for game initialization ensuring the game starts with correct settings based on input parameters.

methods.name: getGameCombinations
methods.description: Provides all possible move combinations for normal and secret modes used to test winner logic.

methods.name: TestGame_getWinner
methods.description: Tests the logic for determining the winner based on player and computer choices across different modes.

methods.name: TestGame_Play
methods.description: Tests the game Play method for managing game state, exit conditions, and move processing.

methods.name: TestGame_isGameOver
methods.description: Verifies the conditions under which a game is considered over according to scores and remaining moves.

methods.name: TestGame_updateScore
methods.description: Confirms the update of scores depending on game outcome.

methods.name: TestGame_getGameOverMessage
methods.description: Checks the end game message correctness depending on the players' final scores.

methods.name: TestGame_getRoundResultMessage
methods.description: Validates the message generated after each game round to ensure correct output for wins, losses, and draws.

methods.name: TestPlayGame
methods.description: Simulates full game sessions with different user move sequences and modes, including error handling.

methods.name: TestParseInt
methods.description: Tests the parseInt function for converting user input strings into valid game settings with default fallbacks.

methods.name: TestGame_getComputerChoice
methods.description: Ensures the computer's choice generation respects the allowed options for both standard and secret modes.

methods.name: TestPlayGame_EnhancedCoverage
methods.description: Additional comprehensive tests for game play with various user input sequences, including early exits and invalid inputs.
